faceRegistration.guide: Position your face in the center of the circle.

collection.title: 1. Personal Data We Collect
collection.preRegistrationBody: InnoLive collects your email address to process your pre-registration.
collection.experienceBody: InnoLive temporarily collects the original facial image you register to provide the demo.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of Use
purpose.preRegistrationBody: We use your email address only to send InnoLive launch notifications and information about pre-registration benefits.
purpose.experienceBody: We use the original facial image only to provide the demo.

retention.title: 3. Retention and Use Period
retention.preRegistrationBody: We retain personal data until you withdraw your consent or the purpose of collection has been fulfilled. We delete it without delay once that purpose has been fulfilled, unless applicable law requires us to retain it for a specified period.
retention.experienceStorage: We do not save the original facial image to a file or database. It is held only in temporary memory and cannot be viewed.
retention.experienceDeletion: Original facial images are deleted every day at 00:00 KST.

refusal.title: 4. Right to Withhold Consent
refusal.preRegistrationBody: You may decline to consent to the collection and use of your personal data. However, you cannot pre-register without providing consent.
refusal.experienceBody: You cannot use the face registration demo if you do not consent to the collection and use of the original facial image.

contact.title: 5. Inquiries and Withdrawal of Consent
contact.beforeEmail: For privacy inquiries or to withdraw your consent, contact
